अभय

ABHAYA was one of the sons of dhṛtarāṣṭra. He was killed by Bhīmasena. (M.B. Ādi Parva, Chapter 67, Verse 104; droṇa parva, Chapter 127, Verse 62).

अभयम्

ABHAYAM . King idhmajihva divided his kingdom plakṣadvīpa into seven parts and gave them to his seven sons. abhayam is one of the parts. The other six parts are:--Śivaṁ, Yamasaṁ, Subhadraṁ, Śāntaṁ, Kṣemaṁ and Amṛtaṁ. See “Idhmajihva”. (bhāgavata, 5th skandha, Chapter 20, Verse 2). It is seen (from M.B. Sabhā Parva, Chapter 30, Verse 9) that the territory known as abhayam was conquered by Bhīmasena. (See Foot-note)
